title: 杀戮尖塔2：分道争锋 / Separate Paths
description:
[h1]杀戮尖塔2：分道争锋 / Separate Paths[/h1]

[b]0.5.4 好友测试版 · 需要 public-beta[/b]
所有玩家须使用相同游戏和模组版本，安装并启用 BaseLib 3.4.7 或更新版本（已验证3.4.7）。兼容基准：游戏v0.111.0 public-beta。

[b]两种联机模式[/b]
异步竞速：共享地图，独立选路、独立战斗；献祭精英/Boss遗物奖励，从诅咒、双刃契约、增益中选择，率先击败第五幕高塔之心者获胜。
同步合作：房主在模组配置中开启“同步模式”，下一局沿用原版共同选路、共同战斗和多人怪物数值。精英/Boss遗物可领取，或献祭换取增益与自身双刃契约。Boss额外奖励直接选增益；不提供诅咒候选，开局不赠送蜥蜴尾巴。

共65项可配置效果。0.5.4修复史莱姆重复布局位移、额外时间线复制恶魔之焰卡住，以及联机奖励登记提前到达造成的等待问题；支持原生动作队列中的主动道具与团队R键重置。

更新后所有人确认0.5.4并新开一局。请移除mods中同ID的手动副本后再使用工坊订阅；BaseLib仍需启用。本包不提供断线续局。

[b]0.5.4 friends-only preview · Requires public-beta[/b]
All players need the same game and mod version, with BaseLib 3.4.7 or later enabled (tested with 3.4.7). Verified baseline: game v0.111.0 public-beta.

Choose independent racing or native cooperative mode in the host's Mod Configuration. Racing retains independent paths, solo battles, opposing Curses and five-act competition. Cooperative mode uses native shared routing, battles and multiplayer monster scaling; Elite/Boss relics may be kept or sacrificed for Boons and self-applied Contracts. Bonus Boss rewards select a Boon directly. Cooperative mode excludes Curses and grants no starting Lizard Tail.

65 configurable effects. Fixes Slime layout drift, Extra Timeline copying Fiend Fire, and multiplayer reward waits. Active items use native action ordering; R Key resets the team together.

Everyone must update to 0.5.4 and start a new run. Remove manual installations with the same mod ID before using the Workshop subscription. Mid-run reconnect is not provided.
changeNote: 0.5.4：新增原版同步合作模式（增益与自身契约，无开局赠送尾巴）；修复史莱姆位移和重叠、额外时间线复制出牌、联机奖励等待；完善主动道具同步与团队R键。需全员更新并新开一局。 / Adds native cooperative mode with Boons and self-applied Contracts, without a starting Tail. Fixes Slime layout drift, Timeline autoplay and reward waits; synchronizes active items and team resets. All players must update and start a new run.
